trust_decision.summary: Whether an exception's message and stack trace may be written onto an OTel span is decided by InstrumentationSettings.include_content; at the pinned commit that decision is applied to span attributes but not to span exception events, so `Span.record_exception` (explicit, or via the SDK's `use_span`) writes the message and traceback on the agent run span, the tool span, the model request span and the realtime session spans.

landing_point.why: The advisory names tool and agent run spans; this is the tool-execution span, the one place that calls `span.record_exception(error, escaped=True)` for every exception escaping tool code, and the agent run span just above it at `:211` leaves exception recording entirely to the OTel SDK's `use_span`.

fix_sites.entry_point: Agent.run / run_sync / run_stream (via `agent.instrument`, `Agent.instrument_all` or the `Instrumentation` capability)
Agent.run tool-call path that fails argument validation
InstrumentedModel.request / request_stream, and Agent.run through Instrumentation.wrap_model_request
FallbackModel.request / request_stream (under an agent run or an InstrumentedModel)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Realtime is a separate session API with its own span tree, a different transport and a static `SessionInstrumentation.record_error` helper that the classic agent path never calls, and embeddings/image generation are separate instrumented model wrappers; the report names exception events on tool and agent run spans, so none of these read as 'the flaw'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: With `include_content=True` each of these spans must still record the full exception event (message and stack trace) and the run span must still carry the `'{type}: {message}'` ERROR description, while a `BaseException`/cancellation must stay unrecorded on the run span even though tool spans record it. An over-broad fix that always strips the event, or that copies the tool span's `except BaseException` onto the run span, breaks both legitimate behaviours.

O6_input_shapes: ToolRetryError whose message is the retry prompt the model sees
ToolFailedError whose message is the failed result the model sees
plain Exception raised by tool code (e.g. ValueError quoting the rejected arguments)
BaseException / cancellation: recorded escaped on tool spans, not recorded at all on the run span
ModelHTTPError carrying the provider's error response body
exception chained from a retry (UnexpectedModelBehavior whose traceback repeats the retry text)
tool-argument ValidationError (already redacted on the validation span)
realtime session error (RealtimeError relaying the provider's error text)
serialized model_request_parameters: a mapping with instruction_parts/prompted_output_template vs an unredactable string fallback rendered from the request
